head: cd9825c947cf67b735d26cc1c42541ccd9d7f637
finding: **S1 — SUGGESTION — Tests, Docs, Robustness.** Artifact: public `author/HANDOFF.md:38` and `:340`, together with the published evidence inventory. Authority/evidence: acceptance items 1–2 require the full arbiter input-cone survey; the packet provides grouped results and hashes but omits `arb_cone.tcl`, its summarizer and the integrated raw table. Impact: a public-only reviewer can reconcile the family coverage and totals but cannot inspect the exact cell/pin filters or reproduce the per-pair extraction from the supplied artifacts. Required outcome if adopted: publish those scripts plus an explicit cell/pin inventory and raw table, or a documented public regeneration command. Verification: enumerate all 187 retained cells/561 selected pins, explain discarded/constant endpoints, and reproduce both totals and extrema. This is a reproducibility improvement, not evidence of an omitted retained cell or a failing path; it does not leave a lens unclean.
disposition: RETAINED as SUGGESTION at c4539ff1. The public round-3 archive still lacks the traversal script and full integrated pair reports. No MINOR/MAJOR/BLOCKER existed in this prior report.

This is an evidence-replay improvement, with no identified incorrect measurement or blocking acceptance defect.
disposition: RETAINED as SUGGESTION at c4539ff1. The public round-3 archive still lacks the traversal script and full integrated pair reports. No MINOR/MAJOR/BLOCKER existed in this prior report.
